posts.title: Comprehension Layer
posts.description: Agents can write code faster than we can understand it. Documents don't fix that. What reviewers need is a briefing: something they can sit back and listen to, and interrupt when it matters.

posts.title: Skills — The Merge Was Right, The Word Wasn't
posts.description: The default is model-invoked. For most of what we build, it should not be.

posts.title: AI's Missing UI
posts.description: The smartest AI agents fail without good UI for reviewing their output. That's why everything becomes a chat app.
